_about: egeria-table.js is pyegeria's renderer for its own structured TABLE result (kind "table"), shipped as package data so the renderer and the shape it draws travel in one release (owner decision D3, 2026-11-14). Its stylesheet is inside the file (EgeriaTable.CSS, injected once). Copied byte for byte from the Egeria Portal, where it was first written; from this release pyegeria is its home, and the Portal and trellis-ui serve this copy (pyegeria.view.renderers). tests/micro-tests/test_renderer_package_data.py checks the sha256 below and that the file is in the wheel.
